rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone or something characterized by narcissism or excessive preoccupation with the self.

example.english: They are always taking selfies in front of the mirror; they’re really narcissistic.
example.traditional: 佢成日對住塊鏡影自拍，真係好自戀。
example.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 deoi3 zyu6 faai3 geng3 jing2 zi6 paak3 zan1 hai6 hou2 zi6 lyun2

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on having an exaggerated sense of one's own importance.

example.english: Don’t be so narcissistic, thinking the whole world has to do what you say.
example.traditional: 你唔好咁自大，以為全世界都要聽你支笛。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 zi6 daai6 ji5 wai4 cyun4 sai3 gaai3 dou1 jiu3 teng1 nei5 zi1 dek6
